continuity_scope: Willow, original 1988 Lucasfilm feature-film continuity only. Official Lucasfilm and Disney+ film profile/authorized original-film retrospective materials are used as a narrow synopsis pass, not a full viewing or screenplay transcription.
coverage_rule: Include every named individual dramatic character directly named and claim-supported in the selected official original-film sources: Willow Ufgood, Elora Danan, and Queen Bavmorda. Peoples/species, magic, prophecy, artifacts, armies, roles, places, factions, unnamed rogue swordsman, and other figures remain terms or omissions.
omissions: Named allies/villains beyond Willow, Elora, and Bavmorda—including the officially described but unnamed rogue swordsman—are omitted because the selected base film synopsis does not provide their names claim by claim.
The Disney+ series, novelizations, comics, games, sourcebook/deleted-scene lore, soundtrack, and any later material are separate witnesses.
Exact spells, prophecy wording, artifacts, armies, places, social groups, transformation details, plot sequence, and ending outcome are omitted except for narrowly cited premise facts.

The original-film premises include an abandoned/prophesied infant, a queen seeking the child, dark forces, creatures, and an ultimate battle. No detailed child-peril, violence, injury, body-horror, or gendered-archetype claim is inferred beyond that official framing.
uncertainties: The official base pages provide synopsis-level claims only, not scene timestamps or a readable authorized screenplay; this is metadata/press-material bounded.
Disney+ calls Willow young while Lucasfilm calls him a farmer and developing sorcerer. No age, training system, or formal title is inferred beyond the specific descriptors.

Lucasfilm references Nelwyn and historical behind-the-scenes use of little people; this research does not use body-size terminology as a character ontology or infer performer identity from fictional people categories.
The official series material states the Disney+ series occurs about 20 years after the 1988 film, so it is not used as proof of original-film continuity details.
evidence_basis: Lucasfilm and Disney first-party original-film/profile material only; no fan wiki, Wikipedia, uninspected film frames, novelization, or adaptation recap is used.
